discovery: Development of polymeric and lipid nanoparticle drug-delivery systems enabling controlled release and targeted delivery of drugs and nucleic acids (including mRNA vaccines)
rationale: The committee recently rewarded materials and biomolecular chemistry (quantum dots, protein design, MOFs), and drug delivery is a long-standing, heavily cited chemistry field it has not yet honored. Langer pioneered polymeric controlled release, Kataoka polymeric micelle nanocarriers, and Cullis the lipid nanoparticles that made siRNA drugs and mRNA COVID-19 vaccines possible. That gives a clear story of chemistry with large medical impact.
